text:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: High error rate from us-east-1 inference cluster (redwood-inference-us-east-1). Threshold breach: 5xx > 10% for 5m. Pager: oncall-jun. Incident ID: INC-20250702-42

oncall-jun: Acked. Seeing increasing 5xx and timeout backs. I'll take primary. Switching service to degraded routing to avoid cascade.

maria: Thanks — can you post initial customer impact summary here so support/Product can triage messaging?

oncall-jun: Early read: affected hosted API text-generation endpoints for ~12% of traffic to model xlarge and some dedicated customers in us-east. Latency spike + 5xx mainly during batching window. No auth failures.

raj: Noted. Which model variants are affected? Any fallback triggers firing?

oncall-jun: model-xlarge-v2 with kv-cache flushes. Automatic fallback to cpu/quantized variant attempted but saw queue pile-up. I pushed a quick policy: route heavy tails to region fallback (us-west) and drop batch coalescing for 1 minute.

alex: Can you paste the mitigation commands you ran? Want to record for postmortem timeline.

oncall-jun: Sure:```sh
# disable batching on group g-llm-hosted for 60s
redwoodctl routing update --group g-llm-hosted --set batching=off --duration 60s
# add fallback region us-west
redwoodctl routing add-fallback --group g-llm-hosted --region us-west
```

oncall-jun: After the routing change 5xx dropped to ~1.8% within 3m, latency normalized.

oncall-bot: :white_check_mark: Handoff reminder in 25m. Please document any follow-ups as action items.

maria: Good mitigation. Request SRE to capture heap/KV cache metrics for the affected hosts; product needs a timeline for customers who experienced degraded results.

sre-liam: I'm already collecting heap/kv logs and will attach perf graphs. ETA 40m for initial artifact.

alex: I'm creating a post-incident thread in #postmortems and scheduling a 60m review. Proposed time: today + 6h. Who's joining?

product-olivia: I'll join — need the severity/customer list first to decide external comms.

oncall-jun: Quick severity assessment: Impacted hosted API customers: medium (some requests timed out, retries succeeded for ~70%), Dedicated: 2 customers experienced elevated tail latency but no data loss. Overall incident severity: Sev2 leaning to Sev3 depending on follow-up validation.

maria: For action items we should capture: (1) Root cause analysis (SRE) (2) Short-term mitigation: better fallback policy (Eng runtime) (3) Long-term: batching algorithm safety limits (Eng-ml) (4) Customer comms + list (Support/Product) (5) Telemetry gap: missing early KV-cache saturation alert (Observability)

alex: I'll own action item tracking. Let's size these and assign priorities: suggest sizing and priority tags in this thread.

raj: Proposals: RCA (L, P0) — needs 2 engineer-days; Mitigation harden (M, P1) — 3 engineer-days; Batching safety limits (L, P0) — 5 engineer-days + eval; Customer comms (S, P0) — 4 engineer-hours; Telemetry alert (S, P1) — 1 engineer-day.

oncall-bot: :hourglass_flowing_sand: Reminder: if incident severity >= Sev2, open a postmortem ticket and link to quarterly planning if action items require roadmap changes.

maria: I can take Customer comms (S, P0). Will coordinate with Support to pull affected customer list.

product-olivia: If RCA indicates model variant-specific behavior, we might prioritize batching safety (P0) for next quarter planning. Please tag relevant roadmap epics.

alex: Created tracking doc: https://redwood.docs/postmortems/INC-20250702-42 (placeholder). Adding initial action items:
- INC-20250702-A1: RCA (owner: liam) size:L priority:P0 due:2025-07-10
- INC-20250702-A2: Short-term fallback policy improvements (owner: raj) size:M priority:P1 due:2025-07-03
- INC-20250702-A3: Batching safety limits (owner: tess) size:L priority:P0 due:2025-08-15 (Q3 roadmap candidate)
- INC-20250702-A4: Customer comms list + messages (owner: maria) size:S priority:P0 due:2025-07-04
- INC-20250702-A5: KV-cache saturation alert + dashboard (owner: alex) size:S priority:P1 due:2025-07-06

tess: I'll take batching safety limits. Will coordinate with eng-ml for testing harness.

liam: RCA accepted. I need access to the routing logs and the specific host IDs. Jun, can you dump the host list and upload the bundle?

oncall-jun: Uploading artifacts now to the incident bucket: s3://redwood-incidents/INC-20250702-42/artifacts.tar.gz

oncall-bot: :inbox_tray: Artifact uploaded by oncall-jun at 1763006120.

alex: Scheduling: postmortem meeting invite sent for today+6h. Agenda: timeline, RCA leads, action item triage, customer impact, Q3 roadmap implications. Please update the doc with any pre-reads.

maria: For prioritization: if RCA shows a repeatable failure mode on specific model sizes, it's P0 for Q3. If single-host noisy neighbor, P1. We'll make final call in the postmortem.

raj: Quick note on sizing: the estimated days assume one engineer fully blocked. If we can pair or run in parallel, deadlines may be sooner. Mention availability in the doc.

product-olivia: Linking this to Quarterly Planning: if action INC-20250702-A3 remains P0, please add to Q3 planning board and we can reprioritize other infra items.

alex: Thanks everyone. I'll keep the action items updated. Afterpostmortem I'll create the Jira epics and link to the quarterly plan. For now, please react with :thumbsup: to own items or :eyes: if you need to reassign.

maria: :thumbsup:

liam: :thumbsup:

raj: :eyes: (may need to reassign part of A2)

oncall-bot: :white_check_mark: Handoff window started. oncall-jun handing to oncall-next in 25m.

oncall-jun: Leaving notes in the incident doc — handoff done. If anything regresses ping me directly.

alex: Closing thread for active mitigation; follow-ups will occur in postmortem doc & Jira.
